mapper.select: SELECT topic AS subjectName, COUNT(id) AS studyCount FROM explanation WHERE user_email = #{userEmail} GROUP BY topic ORDER BY studyCount DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT CONCAT(WEEK(created_at, 1) - WEEK(DATE_SUB(created_at, INTERVAL DAYOFMONTH(created_at) - 1 DAY), 1) + 1, '주차') AS weekLabel, COUNT(id) AS summaryCount FROM explanation WHERE user_email = #{userEmail} AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY weekLabel ORDER BY MIN(created_at) ASC
